title: One gesture vocabulary
description: Every surface moves a panel's controls with these gestures, declared once; each surface maps its own inputs onto them. tools/gestures.mjs is the reference every surface is checked against; docs/panel-gestures.md explains the table. The timings, the thresholds and the table live here and nowhere else in the repo.

longPressMs.description: A press held this long without a drag is a long-press: the word `more`.

doubleTapMs.description: A second tap that begins within this time of the first tap's release is a double-tap.

palmGuardMs.description: Two pointers of one type that both begin inside a control's target within this time of each other are a pinch; a later one is not.

safetyHoldMs.description: How long a control marked `hold` must be held before it acts. A surface may lengthen it and never shorten it below the floor.

claimMs.description: After a step, the control still belongs to the stepper and shows its value text for this long.

words.drag: Move the value with the pointer, relative to where the drag began.
words.fine: A drag at 0.3 of the drag's travel.
words.step: One declared step, else 1% of the normalised travel; coarse is 5 steps. A wheel notch, an encoder detent and an arrow key are one step.
words.second: A handle's Q, by pinch or encoder 3.
words.reset: The declared default, and nothing for a control that declares none. A band's reset is its gain: frequency and Q keep.
words.more: The surface's precise editor or menu. Never a value change.
words.select: Select a bar or a handle. Never a value change.
words.toggle: Flip a switch, on release inside its target.
words.paint: A drag that leaves the pressed bar's column: every bar the pointer enters takes its height, absolute.
